topic.summary: Deep news explainer, 55-60 s, Hinglish: WHAT happened, WHY, and HOW it spread so suddenly, then what it means for the viewer. Use only these reported facts, say 'reported' where needed, no stock tips, no predictions. (1) HOOK: 48 ghante mein AI shares aur crypto dono dhadaam: Google ki company Alphabet ke about $500 billion, yaani lagbhag 47 lakh crore rupaye, ek din mein saaf. (2) WHAT, Tue 28 Oct results: kamaai 25% badhi, Google Cloud double hua, par profit per share $2.12 aaya jabki umeed $3.01 thi, badi wajah SpaceX mein lagaye paise par $8.2 billion ka kaagzi nuksaan. Ek hi quarter mein AI data centres par $51.4 billion kharch, isliye free cash flow minus $9.1 billion; is saal $195-205 billion aur 2027 mein usse bhi zyada kharcha. (3) WHY the fall: investors ka sawaal, itna AI kharcha, paisa wapas kab? Wed 29 Oct share about 12.6% gira, 2004 ke baad sabse bura din. (4) HOW it spread: usi raat Amazon ka cash flow lagataar doosre quarter minus, share about 7% gira; Intel about 23% gira; Microsoft ne chip ki kami se kharche ka forecast ghataya. Agle din Asia: Japan Nikkei about 2.75%, Taiwan about 3% gira, South Korea mein trading rokni padi; China ka CSI 300 bear market mein. (5) CRYPTO same night: duniya ke sabse bade crypto exchange Binance par itihaas ka sabse bada hack, about $6.3 billion, ek engineer ke laptop ke zariye; North Korea ke hackers par shak (reported). Withdrawals band, Bitcoin $77,000 se neeche, 24 ghante mein about $1.5 billion ke udhaar wale daanv zabardasti kat gaye, aur har forced sale ne agla sale karwaya, isliye itna achanak. (6) INDIA: oil about $113-116, rupaya about 95 per dollar; reports ke mutabik Nifty IT ulta upar gaya. (7) WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU: US/tech funds mein kitna paisa hai dekho; crypto exchange par sab paisa mat rakho, aur udhaar (leverage) wale daanv sabse pehle doobte hain; SIP girawat mein band karna sabse mehngi galti. (8) TAKEAWAY: AI ka future bada hai, par har AI share ka nahi. Yeh investment advice nahi hai. Category: ai.
